summary:
Round-3 delta bc216685..218998b1 resolves every round-2 finding I raised that the CTO accepted, and I recommend approval.

(1) Holder-scoped release, my round-2 minor: resolved. insertClaimed uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING provision_claimed_at and returns Optional; empty means the conflict loser. reclaimProvision uses UPDATE ... RETURNING. Each holder keeps its own stamp, and releaseProvision adds AND provision_claimed_at = :m. The column is timestamptz (V8), which reads into OffsetDateTime with pgjdbc and round-trips at microsecond precision, so the equality is exact. create() is not @Transactional, so each now() is the time of its own statement. No schema change, as the CTO ruled.

(2) Overrun test: staleReleaseLeavesTakeoverLeaseIntact holds A inside createOrder until B reclaims the expired 2 s lease and is inside createOrder itself. It then fails A and asserts the stored lease still equals B's stamp and is not null, and that B publishes order_b. Without the :mine predicate, A's release would set the lease to NULL and the test would fail, so it proves the fix.

(3) addSuppressed, my round-2 nit: resolved. A release failure is added as suppressed to the original createOrder exception, which is rethrown, so UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE and its root cause are kept. The comment says a timeout counts as a failure and accepts an orphan order as the worst case (CTO item 4).

(4) Moved validation test, my round-2 nit: resolved. It was a pure rename, 100% similarity, into test/.../payment/config/, matching its package.

(5) STRIPE-flip publish test, my round-2 nit: resolved for mode. publishIsGuardedAgainstModeSwitch flips mode to STRIPE inside createOrder and asserts no order id is stored, so removing the mode predicate would fail it. The method predicate is still untested (nit).

Still open, all nits or deferred: the V8 checksum note, the claimUncaptured index and the optional race test, plus new cosmetic nits (a Javadoc sentence, FQN types). The delta adds no duplication: it reuses the JdbcClient query().optional() pattern and the standard Throwable.addSuppressed. Verify is recorded at this SHA: 97 tests, 0 failures; slice-2 production lines are 520, under the 600 limit.

Counts: blocker 0, major 0, minor 0, nit 6.
